opennyai_summary.decision:
This case is taken up through Hybrid mode in the 2nd National High Court Level Lok Adalat.
Vide Judgment dated 08.05.2018, said matter got disposed of with an award of compensation to the tune of Rs.9,65,000/- (rupees nine lakhs sixty-five thousand only) with simple interest @ 7% per annum from 26.07.2017 till actual payment.
It was directed for deposit of Rs.3,00,000/- in the // 2 // name of respondent no.3 and Rs.1,00,000/- each in the name of respondent nos.1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 be kept as fixed deposit with quarterly interest for a period of five years in any nationalized Bank and the rest amount of Rs.1,65,000 along with the accrued interest of the award be paid in shape of cheque to respondent no.1 and further directed that no premature withdrawal shall be allowed without leave of the Tribunal.
4.
1 5. With the consent of Smt. Amulya Mohanty, learned counsel for the appellants and on concession of Sri Saroj Kumar Padhy, Advocate for the respondents, it is agreed that the awarded compensation amount of Rs.9,65,000/- be enhanced to Rs.11,85,555/- (consolidated).
The said consolidated amount of Rs.11,85,555/- (Rupees Eleven Lakhs Eighty-Five Thousands Five Hundred Fifty-five only) shall be deposited before the learned Tribunal within eight weeks hence.
On such deposit being made, the said amount shall be disbursed to the claimants/respondents proportionately in the terms as directed by the learned Tribunal in the impugned Award.
6. The statutory amount deposited in the Registry of this Court, as stated to have been invested in Allhabad Bank, Cantonment Road vide office note dated 27.10.2018, along with the accrued interest thereon shall be refunded to the // 3 // appellant-Odisha Road Transport Corporation, on filing of receipt showing such deposit.
7. Accordingly, MACA is disposed of.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
